g.text: Complete n8n Architecture Flow: Google Sheets ➔ Playwright CDP ➔ Codex-lb AI ➔ LaTeX PDF ➔ Google Drive
Processes jobs 1-by-1 sequentially in batches of 1
• Multi-account load balancer (pools free/paid ChatGPT accounts)
• Runs GPT-5.6-Luna model with deep reasoning
• Evaluates 100-point rubric, extracts facts, tailors LaTeX resume
• Validates matching score (0-100%) & referral msg (<500 chars)
Master resume is the ONLY authoritative source for facts. Never invents skills, companies, metrics, or credentials.
Codex-lb pools multiple ChatGPT accounts under a single key. Free tier accounts can be chained to avoid rate limits.
Injects directive metadata into the PDF Subject property to instruct automated ATS LLM scanners.
Single click processes all target jobs, builds custom resumes, extracts salary/skills, and gathers LinkedIn leads.
